JSON-cookie parsing and the later addition of automatic rejected-promise handling are documented in [cookie-parser](https://expressjs.com/en/resources/middleware/cookie-parser/) and the [Express 5 migration guide](https://expressjs.com/en/guide/migrating-5/).
